verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own local-first design supports this story: it 'runs entirely on your computer' with 'no data leaving your device', so data processed locally is never handed to anyone who could train on it. But nothing explicitly addresses model-training use, and the product also supports cloud LLM API keys, where data leaves the device. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-use policy, a documented training opt-out or guarantee when cloud LLM providers are used, and independent verification that no data leaves the device.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your computer.
Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
No bots joining your meeting. No cloud processing.
get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
